mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy shift, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, causing a negative S&P 500 return over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 105.0 indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO is above 105.0 during late-cycle expansions.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output, which typically boosts corporate profits and leads to positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and declines in nonfarm payrolls indicate a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 50% of cases over a 3-year period.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery periods, a decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary stimulus, which typically boosts equity valuations and produces positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% during post-shock recoveries.
